title: Painting a Realistic Urban Sketch with Gouache
content: Here's a quick video where I paint some ordinary commercial shopfronts on an overcast day using gouache.To achieve realism—and to speed things up—I use flat brushes and I paint patches of color that I subdivide with dark strokes.
